summary: Master waste prevention technologies, circular economy frameworks, and LCA methodologies. Join our 5-day professional training to achieve zero waste targets.
lede: Waste prevention and reduction training helps environmental and operations professionals find where materials are wasted and plan source reduction. Learners practice mapping material flows with Sankey diagrams, applying lean 5S methods, and using life-cycle assessment to compare waste impacts and inform closed-loop system design.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is tailored for professionals tasked with the technical and strategic oversight of material efficiency and environmental impact.
modules: Material Flow Analysis and Sankey Mapping
Life Cycle Assessment for Waste Reduction
Lean and 5S Integration in Waste Prevention
Circular Economy Design and Closed-Loop Systems
Extended Producer Responsibility and Supply Chain
Digital Waste Tracking and AI Analytics
Strategic Waste Reduction Roadmap and Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of environmental management systems or industrial operations. Experience with ISO 14001 or corporate sustainability reporting is recommended but not mandatory. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data-based exercises is required.
